key_insight: FK-ReMask steers pretrained crystal diffusion models toward target properties by revising both crystal geometry and elemental composition without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The method could help screen candidate photovoltaic materials against multiple physical targets before costly simulation or fabrication.
method: Maintain multiple denoising trajectories and replicate promising candidates using Feynman–Kac particle selection.
Re-mask committed atom types so generation can explore alternative elemental compositions.
Apply gradient-free, inference-time steering to continuous and discrete generation channels.
evidence_signal: Across four electronic, photovoltaic, and mechanical objectives, the abstract reports improved yields of stable, unique, novel and property-on-target materials, plus joint steering of three photovoltaic properties.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical gains, computational overhead, or experimental solar-cell validation.
paper_title: Multi-property Feynman-Kac Steering of Crystal Diffusion Models
